_what_this_is: Three voices for SS MERIDIAN. Materials in this ship's language; every horizontal anchor is the dado's polished chrome capping strip at 1.20 m.

dado_band.line: the dado's chrome capping strip above the floor
dado_band.sentence: A clearly legible dado of dark macassar-ebony veneer runs corner to corner on every exposed wall surface including the side-wall returns, capped by a polished chrome half-round strip whose top edge is at exactly 1.20 m above the floor, interrupted only by the doorway.
dado_band.label: DADO CAPPING STRIP 1.20 M ABOVE FLOOR - GATE ANCHOR
dado_band.why: This ship's universal anchor: every inboard first-class wall carries the same dark veneer dado under the same chrome strip at one height. A painter draws it and the instrument finds it.

writing_room_maple.why: The writing room is the small quiet room: pale bird's-eye maple above the dark dado, a plain blue carpet, nothing to distract a letter.
writing_room_maple.walls: pale bird's-eye maple veneer in tall book-matched panels above the dado; below the dado's chrome capping strip, dark macassar-ebony veneer
writing_room_maple.ceiling: a flat cream painted plaster ceiling meeting the walls in a shallow stepped cove
writing_room_maple.floor: a plain deep-blue fitted carpet, close-piled and unpatterned
writing_room_maple.blank: unbroken pale bird's-eye maple veneer above the dado's chrome capping strip with dark macassar-ebony veneer below

gallery_walnut.why: The long gallery is the deep room: warm walnut running away down its whole length under the same cream ceiling, its linoleum polished by a season of promenading.
gallery_walnut.walls: warm figured walnut veneer in tall book-matched panels above the dado; below the dado's chrome capping strip, dark macassar-ebony veneer
gallery_walnut.ceiling: a flat cream painted plaster ceiling meeting the walls in a shallow stepped cove
gallery_walnut.floor: a plain polished buff linoleum floor, lightly scuffed, unpatterned
gallery_walnut.blank: unbroken warm figured walnut veneer above the dado's chrome capping strip with dark macassar-ebony veneer below

saloon_sycamore.why: The grand saloon is the ship's public face: pale figured sycamore, a red carpet, and one blank chrome medallion on the wall.
saloon_sycamore.walls: pale figured sycamore veneer in tall book-matched panels above the dado; below the dado's chrome capping strip, dark macassar-ebony veneer; a single blank round brushed-chrome medallion mounted on the wall
saloon_sycamore.ceiling: a flat cream painted plaster ceiling meeting the walls in a shallow stepped cove
saloon_sycamore.floor: a deep-pile fitted carpet in terracotta red with a small all-over geometric pattern
saloon_sycamore.blank: unbroken pale figured sycamore veneer above the dado's chrome capping strip with dark macassar-ebony veneer below
